item.title: Iranians Condemn Strike on a Top University
item.summary: Government officials and anti-government activists alike denounced the attacks on the Sharif University of Technology in Tehran, the latest Iranian center for higher education to be targeted.

item.title: Trump’s Board of Peace Gives Hamas Disarmament Deadline
item.summary: The demand reflects both the U.S. administration’s eagerness to secure a lasting cease-fire in Gaza and its growing impatience with the Palestinian militant group.

item.title: Trump Moves Deadline for Iran to Open Strait of Hormuz
item.summary: The new deadline comes as the president and Iranian leaders have ramped up bombastic threats against one another.

item.title: At Least 4 Killed in Iranian Strike in Haifa, Israeli Officials Say
item.summary: Rescue workers recovered four bodies from a residential building in the port city of Haifa after air defenses failed to intercept an Iranian strike, Israeli officials said.

item.title: Seyed Majid Khademi, Iranian Intelligence Chief, Killed in Overnight Attack
item.summary: Israel claimed responsibility for the death of Major General Seyed Majid Khademi, the spy chief of the Islamic Revolutionary Guards Corps, the latest senior official to be killed in the war.

item.title: On Iran, Trump Keeps World Off Balance With Ever-Changing Threats
item.summary: Global leaders are struggling in their efforts to find a way to end the American-Israeli war on Iran, and they are spooked about what President Trump might do next.

item.title: Here’s What Happened in the War in the Middle East on Sunday
item.summary: President Trump taunted Iran on social media, while strikes continued in Iran, Israel, Lebanon and some Gulf states.

item.title: Trump’s Lesson From Risky Rescue: Threaten to Go Harder at Iran
item.summary: In an expletive-laced social media post, the president said Iran should open the Strait of Hormuz or he would bomb bridges and power plants.

item.title: Here’s a Timeline of Trump’s Ultimatums Over the Strait of Hormuz
item.summary: President Trump first gave Iran 48 hours to reopen the vital oil shipping route on March 21. The deadline has been reset many times since.

item.title: Trump Revels in Threats to Commit War Crimes in Iran
item.summary: The president said he would bomb Iran “back to the Stone Ages.” Until this administration, American leaders had insisted they were trying to follow international law in war.
